subdivision_of_building: This proposal covers no buildings as it is for temporary event and structures on open land.
description: Temporary use of part of Clapham Common for 2025 Oktoberfest event, involving installation and de-installation of temporary infrastructure including fencing, big top tent, lighting and other temporary structures, and other ancillary works (set up commencing 2nd October with events from 10th October to 25th October with dismantling and off-sire by 31st October).
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - This permission is for a limited period of 30 days from 2nd October expiring on 31st October and the works hereby permitted must be removed (and the land restored to its former condition) by or before 31st October 2025 in accordance with policies LP1, LP2 and LP14 of the Local Plan.
Reason: The application for the erection of the event structures is for a limited period, the event structures is of a temporary nature and is unsuitable for retention on a permanent basis, to comply with Section 72 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.
Condition : 2 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the reports, specifications and drawings detailed Site Location Plan, Plan Drawing OKT20251003, dated 26 June 2025; Proposed Wider Site Plan, dated 20 June 2025; Oktoberfest 2025 Clapham Common - Event Operation and Access Plan Statement, dated September 2025; Clapham Common Events 2025, Temporary Use Planning Application, EventLambeth Events Strategy, dated June 2025; Traffic Management Plan, Version 1.2, dated 15 August 2025; Oktoberfest on the Common 2025 - Ground Management Plan, Version 1.2; Noise Management Strategy, Version 1.2, prepared by Joynes Nash Acoustic Consultants, dated October 2025; Ecology Management Plan 2024-2025; OOTC25 - Vehicle Movements accessing the site during the site set up and de-rig; OOTC25 - Site Safety Induction; Construction Management Plan; Version 1.2, dated 26 September 2025 & OOTC25 - Cycle Parking Details, dated August 2025.
Reason: To ensure a satisfactory standard of development and to allow the local planning authority to review any potential changes to the scheme. 
Condition : 3 - The noise level management measures and procedures contained within Noise Management Strategy, prepared by Joynes Nash Acoustic Consultants, dated October 2025 in its entirety shall be implemented as part of the works pertaining to this temporary permission.
Reason: To protect the amenities of neighbouring occupiers, in accordance with policies LP2 and LP14 of the Local Plan.
Condition : 4 - INFORMATIVE: In dealing with this application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to work with the applicant in a positive and proactive manner and the Council has, as far as practicable, sought solutions to problems arising in relation to dealing with the planning application. The Council has made available detailed advice in the form of its statutory policies in the Local Plan (2023) as well as offering a full pre-application advice service, in order to ensure that the applicant has been given every opportunity to submit an application which is likely to be considered favourably. In addition, where appropriate, further guidance was offered to the applicant during the processing of the application.

open_spaces_details.description: Temporary fencing and structures for temporary change of use for event to take place.
